picks.title: 花匠刺客
picks.summary: 温和低调的花匠，实则是顶尖刺客，一心逃离血腥过往。他偶然结识揭发警界腐败的关键证人，对方遭黑警追杀，他的真实身份也随之曝光。为保护证人，他不得不重拾武器，对抗庞大的黑警集团，浴血奋战。
picks.summaryEn: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

picks.title: 哈奴曼化身
picks.summary: 一个悲伤的男孩寻求上帝，希望能与他逝去的母亲重逢。在追寻神性的过程中，他学会用爱、食物和无声的祝福的奇迹来服务人类，最终成为哈奴曼化身——尼姆·卡罗利·巴巴。
picks.summaryEn: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

picks.title: 火柴盒大电影
picks.summary: 一群儿时好友重聚后，生活发生巨变。曾离开家乡的前领袖、中央情报局卧底特工肖恩突然归来，意外将众人卷入一场紧张的国际追逐行动，必须合力拯救世界。
picks.summaryEn: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

picks.title: 挖掘者
picks.summary: 世界上最有权势的男子极力证明自己其实是人类的救世主，结果等来了他酝酿的灾难要摧毁万物。
picks.summaryEn: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.
